units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>קרוב ופייטן</he> Ar. (ed., a. Pesik. Ul’ḳaḥ. p. 179ᵃ <he>פייטן ודרשן</he>) hymnologist and poet; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6:4">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite> <he>קָרֵיבוֹי ופייטויי</he>.
Y. Ber. I, 3ᶜ bot. [read:] ר׳ … הוה סמיך לק׳ וכ׳ R. Z. (in his prayer of the section Modim) kept pace with the reader in order to bow simultaneously with him at the beginning and at the end.
Lev. R. s. 19; Cant. R. to V, 11 ר׳ אלכסנדרי ק׳ R. A. the hymnologist.—[In liturgy קרובות (not קרובץ): the poetical insertions, on special occasions, in the Prayer of Benedictions.]
